+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .types import _NumberRangeBase
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class ClosedUpperNumericBound(_NumberRangeBase):
+    """Use an inclusive upper-bound comparison for numeric ranges."""
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> t.Any:
+        import operator
+
+        rv = super(_NumberRangeBase, self).convert(value, param, ctx)
+        lt_min: bool = self.min is not None and (
+            operator.le if self.min_open else operator.lt
+        )(rv, self.min)
+        gt_max: bool = self.max is not None and operator.gt(rv, self.max)
+
+        if self.clamp:
+            if lt_min:
+                return self._clamp(self.min, 1, self.min_open)  # type: ignore
+
+            if gt_max:
+                return self._clamp(self.max, -1, self.max_open)  # type: ignore
+
+        if lt_min or gt_max:
+            self.fail(
+                _("{value} is not in the range {range}.").format(
+                    value=rv, range=self._describe_range()
+                ),
+                param,
+                ctx,
+            )
+
+        return rv
notes:
